config.zoomitsky.title: ZoomitSky Configuration
config.zoomitsky.defaultZoom.tooltip: Initial zoom level. This is the value used by the Reset Zoom Distance key.
config.zoomitsky.minZoom.tooltip: Changes the far limit of the zoom. Lower values = more zoom.
config.zoomitsky.maxZoom.tooltip: Changes the minimum distance where zoom starts. A value of 1 makes the zoom imperceptible when too close.
config.zoomitsky.zoomStep.tooltip: How much the zoom level changes per mouse wheel tick.
config.zoomitsky.transitionDuration.tool: How long the zoom animation takes.
config.zoomitsky.easingType.tooltip: The easing curve used in the zoom transition. Controls how it accelerates and decelerates.
config.zoomitsky.cinematicBarsSpeed.tool: How fast the black bars appear and disappear when using Cinematic Zoom.
config.zoomitsky.tp.defaultDistance.tool: Camera distance when activating third person zoom. Press the reset key to return to this value.
config.zoomitsky.tp.minDistance.tooltip: The closest the camera can be to the player using the mouse wheel.
config.zoomitsky.tp.maxDistance.tooltip: The farthest the camera can be from the player using the mouse wheel.
config.zoomitsky.tp.distanceStep.tooltip: How much the camera distance changes per mouse wheel tick in third person.
config.zoomitsky.tp.transitionDuration.t: How long the camera distance animation takes. Set to 0.00s for instant movement.
config.zoomitsky.tp.easingType.tooltip: The easing curve used in the third person distance transition.
